start_caption: Hey {full_name}! 👋 {bot_name} me aapka swagat hai. Main aapke Telegram account ko ek powerful userbot me badal deta hoon — Tag All, Auto DM, VC Music aur Meme Sounds ke saath. Neeche diye buttons se shuru karein 👇
help_menu: 📖 Help Menu Neeche apna feature chunein, har ek ka apna command set hai.
tagall_help: 🏷 Tag All .tagall {msg} — Group ke sabhi members ko ek-ek karke tag karta hai (typing animation ke saath). Message optional hai. .cancel — Chal rahe tagall ko rok deta hai.
autodm_help: 🤖 Auto DM .autodm on — Auto DM chalu karein .autodm off — Auto DM band karein Default: ON. Jab koi naya user aapko DM karta hai to yeh auto-reply bhejta hai.
vcsong_help: 🎵 VC Song .play {song name} — VC me audio play karein .vplay {song name} — VC me video play karein .stop — Playback rokein .end — VC call end karein .skip — Queue ka agla gaana play karein Note: Group me koi thumbnail/player button nahi dikhega. Sab kuch is bot ke DM se control hota hai.
meme_help: 😂 Meme Sounds .meme {filename} — Us naam ki meme/voice clip ko VC me stream karta hai.
login_ask_number: Step 3/5 Apna Telegram number bhejein (country code ke saath, jaise +91XXXXXXXXXX).
login_ask_otp: Step 4/5 Aapke number par OTP bheja gaya hai. Wo OTP yahan bhejein. Agar OTP me spaces daalne hain (jaise 1 2 3 4 5) to daal sakte hain.
login_ask_password: Step 5/5 Aapke account par 2FA Password laga hai. Please apna password bhejein.
login_not_allowed: ⛔ Ye bot private use ke liye hai. Aapko login karne ki permission nahi hai.
login_limit_reached: ⛔ Login limit ({max_logins}) poori ho chuki hai.
login_already: ⚠️ Aap already logged in hain. Pehle /logout karein.
login_failed: ❌ Login fail ho gaya: {error} Dobara try karne ke liye /login bhejein.
login_cancelled: ❌ Login process cancel kar diya gaya.
logout_success: ✅ Aap successfully logout ho gaye hain.
activeac_none: ⚠️ Koi bhi account abhi login nahi hai.
broadcast_usage: ⚠️ Kisi image/video/document/text message ko reply karke /broadcast bhejein.
owner_only: ⛔ Ye command sirf owner use kar sakta hai.
not_logged_in: ⚠️ Pehle /login karein is feature ko use karne ke liye.
tagall_no_task: ⚠️ Koi active tagall nahi chal raha.
